title: I Reported the Hallway Cargo-Bike With the Serial on the No-Storage Sign

parts.text: I reported the cargo-bike at 8:17 p.m. with the serial taped under the no-storage sign it blocked. The sign said NO STORAGE. FIRE LANE. I was forty-two, tenant, standing in a hall that made me look like I owned the egress. Neighbor Lumen said bikes were atmosphere. I photographed the serial, the sign, and the blocked door. Then I let the portal keep the timestamp. Lumen laughed until the super asked for the still. The bike moved. Lumen serial-dates the hall now. A sign is only a sign until someone treats it like a clock.

social.video_title: The cargo-bike serial sat under the no-storage sign — Part 1/1
social.description: Fire lane, blocked door, a portal still. The super asked for the photo. Has a hallway ever become a garage?
